# Vendored: A2A JSON Schema bundle, v1.0.1

`a2a-v1.0.1.schema.json` is the JSON Schema bundle the A2A project publishes at
`https://a2a-protocol.org/v1.0.1/spec/a2a.json`, fetched 2026-11-12, unmodified
(75,186 bytes, SHA-256
`ba4b702b5edbdcbfe972c272484eb38e1fcd72af3c0b7eaa114b50e97455d8dd`).

The A2A project's own README calls it a non-normative build artifact generated
from `specification/a2a.proto`. It carries types and `additionalProperties:
false` but no `required` lists; the required fields this crate checks are the
ones marked `REQUIRED` in the proto at tag `v1.0.1`.
